construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation authored directly in the isolated build directory.
construction.runtime: Python 3 standard library; invoke with -B to suppress bytecode files.

shared_schema.input: schema_version, synthetic=true, fixed timezone-aware as_of, research, guided, behavior, semantic
shared_schema.output: One JSON snapshot: schema_version, synthetic, status, stage, as_of, sources, findings, guided, behavior, semantic.
shared_schema.validation: Shared structural and industry validation checks each stage boundary, identity links, provenance membership, minimized record fields, disclosures and uniform reasoned claims triage.
shared_schema.provenance: Allowlisted source URL, source format, SHA-256 of canonical retrieved payload, deterministic retrieved_at from as_of, logical normalized record pointer, record membership.
shared_schema.error_contract: CLI validation, decoding and file errors emit one JSON object with status=error and exit 2. Successful CLI emits one JSON object and exits 0.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated minimized findings, source hashes, linked policy identifiers, disclosed underwriting factors.
Prerequisite-checked readiness, eligible policy identifiers and explicit coverage preferences.
Recency-weighted policy rankings provide a bounded relevance boost for indexed policies and their linked claims/submissions.

behavior.research: Offline retrieval from inline synthetic fixtures; optional injected retriever(url) returns format-matching fixture data. Exact HTTPS allowlisted hosts; no credentials, query, fragments or redirects. No HTTP client or live retrieval is implemented.
behavior.formats: Illustrative ACORD-style XML/JSON Policy, Claim and UnderwritingSubmission records, plus strict colon-delimited claim-form text. Not an official ACORD schema.
behavior.onboarding: Ordered review_minimization -> review_disclosures -> choose_preferences. Partial progress is returned, with behavioral ranking and search blocked until completion.
behavior.ranking: Browse weight 1, purchase weight 3, decayed by 2^(-age_days/half_life_days). Explicit peril preference adds 0.25. No activity uses deterministic cold-start ranking. Identifier tie-breaking.
behavior.search: Deterministic synonym-normalized TF-IDF cosine index over all three entity types. Match relevance plus at most 0.1 normalized behavioral prior. Optional injected embedding(text) vectors are finite, nonzero and dimension-consistent; cosine is mixed equally with lexical relevance.
industry_rules: Claims receive uniform coverage-based eligibility/manual-review triage and stated reasons; human review is always required, never automated denial, settlement or approval.
Raw invented policyholder names, email, fabricated VIN and address are discarded; only synthetic holder references propagate. Event fields are minimized. No compliance certification.
Every underwriting factor must be explicitly disclosed and acknowledged; unknown or sensitive factors are rejected.
behavior.synthetic_fixtures: All policyholders and properties are invented, VINs fabricated. Tests use random.Random(119) for reproducible randomized loss amounts and dates. No live model, network or provider is used.
behavior.determinism: Fixed as_of controls retrieval timestamps and event recency. Stable ordering, canonical hashes and fixed synonym vocabulary. Injected callables must themselves be deterministic.

excluded: Production GDPR or insurance compliance certification
Automated claims denial or underwriting pricing

test_outcomes.cli_output: Exactly one JSON object with status=ok.
test_outcomes.validation: All stage, handoff, privacy, disclosure, fair-triage, invalid-input, injected-callable and CLI tests passed.
